invariant: A final holdout may be evaluated only after a model and its selection policy are frozen. Feedback from the final holdout must never be used to select or change that model under the same final-evaluation claim.
limits: The protocol runs in memory and does not enforce access across processes or machines
SHA-256 detects modification against the stored ledger but is not externally anchored
The alternate m1 holdout is a synthetic scenario, not a second permitted comparison within one evaluation session
